propositions: Standing eval fixture for T15 requires a packaged YAML spec with registered deterministic scorers and balanced pass/finding/not-applicable dataset.
Applicable/pass cases must cover deployed-service plans naming boot, authentication, authorization, connectivity, readiness risks with concrete proof and scoped cleanup.
Applicable/finding cases must include slow delivery-loop feedback and destructive-cleanup scenarios (pre-existing table drop, shared bucket wipe).
Not-applicable/pass cases must cover app-only, library-only, CLI-only, docs-only, health-route, incidental deploy plans plus S2/S3 boundaries.
Unit tests must validate case identifiers, labels, scorer discipline, applicability matrix, and spec loading through public eval loader.
Documented false positives in observed-false-positives.md form regression guards for application-scope negatives.
